name: Slow Cooker Braised Beef Short Ribs
ingredients_verbatim: 3-4 pounds beef short ribs, about 8 short ribs, boneless or bone-in
4 cloves garlic, peeled and left whole
1/2 cup red wine (Cabernet Sauvignon or Pinot Noir), optional but highly recommended! Sub with additional beef broth.
Chopped fresh parsley and thyme sprigs, optional garnish
unmapped: beef short ribs (board has chuck-roast/ribeye/sirloin only, no short rib home)
why: Slow-cooker beef braise dead-center in band: published 533 cal / 9g carb / 50g protein per serving. Structurally low-carb (meat + aromatics + broth, no starch base) and high-protein. Fills an open lane (no short-rib braise in the 544-recipe catalog) and intentionally carries the unmapped short-rib + wine/herb flags that prove the pricer lane. Batch-scales cleanly to 14 servings by weight; sub extra beef broth for the wine to keep it commodity-friendly.
